title: In the nick of time: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 38
content:
## In the nick of time

**Word Power 38 · English idioms**

### Meaning

At the very last moment; just in time before something bad happens.

### Usage

1. We got there just in the nick of time.
2. We got to the platform in the nick of time, just as the guard was blowing his whistle.

### How to use it

In the nick of time means just before it would be too late. Compare on time, which simply means according to the schedule. The phrase usually suggests a narrow escape from a problem.

### Another example

We reached the library in the nick of time, just before the doors were locked.

### Check your understanding

If a train leaves at nine and you arrive at eight, is that normally 'in the nick of time'?

### Suggested answer

No. Arriving an hour early is comfortably early. In the nick of time would suggest arriving just before departure.
